title: Looking after a neighbour's dog for the long weekend
context: You will hear two neighbours in a townhouse complex in Nanaimo talking about caring for a dog.

segments.speaker: Tomasz
segments.text: Hey, Priya, got a minute? It's Tomasz, from number twelve. I have a huge favour to ask, and feel free to say no.

segments.speaker: Tomasz
segments.text: We're driving to Tofino on Friday for the long weekend, and the kennel we always use just called. They double-booked, so they can't take Biscuit after all. Is there any chance you could look in on him while we're away?

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: I'd be glad to. My kids are always begging to walk him anyway. What would I need to do?

segments.speaker: Tomasz
segments.text: Not much, honestly. One scoop of food in the morning and one at night, and a walk around the block twice a day. The only tricky part is his pills. They're for his joints, and he'll spit them out unless you hide them in a bit of cheese.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Sounds like my youngest with vitamins. Where will the key be?

segments.speaker: Tomasz
segments.text: In a lockbox by the back door. I'll text you the code tonight. And please keep him on the leash near the creek. Last summer he chased a duck into the water, and it took me an hour to get him out.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Noted. No creek adventures. What if he gets sick?

segments.speaker: Tomasz
segments.text: The vet's number is on the fridge, and I've told them you can make decisions for him. I'd cover any bills, of course. And I want to pay you for your time, too.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Absolutely not. You shovelled our whole driveway in January when I had the flu. Bring me back some smoked salmon from Tofino and we're even.

segments.speaker: Tomasz
segments.text: Deal. You're a lifesaver. I was starting to think we'd have to cancel the whole trip.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Well, now you don't. Actually, why don't you bring Biscuit over tomorrow evening for half an hour, so he can get used to us before you leave?

segments.speaker: Tomasz
segments.text: Good idea. We'll come by after dinner.

questions.prompt: Why does Tomasz need Priya's help?

options.text: His dog is too sick to travel to Tofino.
options.whyVi: Có nhắc 'pills' và 'sick', nhưng chó uống thuốc khớp; không ai nói nó ốm không đi được.

options.text: The kennel is closed for the long weekend.
options.whyVi: Đúng là trại không nhận chó, nhưng lý do là nhận trùng chỗ, không phải đóng cửa.

options.text: The place that usually boards his dog has no room for it.
options.whyVi: Đúng: trại chó quen nhận trùng lịch ('double-booked') nên không còn chỗ cho Biscuit.

options.text: Priya's children asked to take care of his dog.
options.whyVi: Các con Priya thích dắt chó, nhưng đó không phải lý do Tomasz nhờ giúp.

questions.evidence: They double-booked, so they can't take Biscuit after all.
questions.explanationVi: 'Double-booked' = nhận trùng lịch, nên 'can't take Biscuit'. Đáp án C diễn đạt lại: nơi thường gửi chó 'has no room for it'.

questions.prompt: What does Tomasz say about Biscuit's medication?

options.text: It has to be disguised in food or the dog will refuse it.
options.whyVi: Đúng: phải giấu thuốc trong miếng phô mai, nếu không chó sẽ nhổ ra.

options.text: It should be given with each scoop of food.
options.whyVi: Một muỗng thức ăn sáng và tối là chuyện cho ăn; Tomasz không nói thuốc uống theo mỗi bữa.

options.text: It is a vitamin for his joints.
options.whyVi: 'Vitamins' là chuyện con út của Priya; thuốc của chó là 'pills' cho khớp.

options.text: The vet will deliver it on Friday.
options.whyVi: Không ai nói bác sĩ thú y mang thuốc tới.

questions.evidence: he'll spit them out unless you hide them in a bit of cheese
questions.explanationVi: 'Hide them in a bit of cheese' ↔ 'disguised in food'; 'spit them out' ↔ 'refuse it'. Đáp án A.

questions.prompt: Why does Tomasz mention what happened last summer?

options.text: To explain why Biscuit is afraid of water.
options.whyVi: Chó tự lao xuống nước đuổi vịt, tức là không sợ nước.

options.text: To suggest that Priya walk him near the creek.
options.whyVi: Tomasz muốn tránh rủi ro ở gần con lạch, không khuyến khích đi đó.

options.text: To show that the dog needs two walks a day.
options.whyVi: Hai lần đi dạo mỗi ngày là thông tin riêng, không liên quan chuyện hè năm ngoái.

options.text: To explain why the dog must not be allowed to run free there.
options.whyVi: Đúng: Biscuit từng đuổi vịt xuống nước, nên phải giữ dây xích gần con lạch.

questions.evidence: And please keep him on the leash near the creek. Last summer he chased a duck into the water, and it took me an hour to get him out.
questions.explanationVi: Câu chuyện hè năm ngoái là lý do cho lời dặn 'keep him on the leash near the creek'. 'Must not be allowed to run free' = phải giữ dây xích. Đáp án D.

questions.prompt: How does Priya respond to Tomasz's offer to pay her?

options.text: She accepts but asks for less money.
options.whyVi: Cô từ chối thẳng: 'Absolutely not'.

options.text: She firmly refuses because she wants to repay an earlier kindness.
options.whyVi: Đúng: Tomasz từng xúc tuyết cả lối xe cho nhà cô khi cô bị cúm.

options.text: She is offended that he would offer money.
options.whyVi: Cô từ chối dứt khoát nhưng không có lời nào cho thấy bị xúc phạm; cô còn đùa xin cá hồi.

options.text: She says she will decide after the weekend.
options.whyVi: Cô không hoãn quyết định.

questions.evidence: Absolutely not. You shovelled our whole driveway in January when I had the flu.
questions.explanationVi: 'Absolutely not' = từ chối dứt khoát. Câu tiếp theo nêu lý do: anh từng giúp cô hồi tháng Một. 'We're even' cho thấy cô coi đây là trả ơn. Đáp án B.

questions.prompt: What will Tomasz most likely do tomorrow evening?

options.text: Text Priya the code for the lockbox.
options.whyVi: Anh nhắn mã khóa vào tối nay ('tonight'), không phải tối mai.

options.text: Drive to Tofino with his family.
options.whyVi: Gia đình anh đi vào thứ Sáu.

options.text: Take his dog to Priya's place for a short visit.
options.whyVi: Đúng: Priya đề nghị đưa Biscuit sang nửa tiếng để quen nhà, Tomasz đồng ý sang sau bữa tối.

options.text: Buy smoked salmon for Priya.
options.whyVi: Cá hồi hun khói anh sẽ mua ở Tofino khi về, không phải tối mai.

questions.evidence: why don't you bring Biscuit over tomorrow evening for half an hour, so he can get used to us before you leave?
questions.explanationVi: Priya đề nghị 'bring Biscuit over tomorrow evening for half an hour', Tomasz trả lời 'We'll come by after dinner'. 'For half an hour' ↔ 'a short visit'. Đáp án C.

vocabulary.vi: nhận trùng lịch, đặt trùng chỗ
vocabulary.definition: having accepted two bookings for the same time or space
vocabulary.example: The kennel double-booked, so they can't take our dog.

vocabulary.definition: to visit someone or something briefly to check that everything is fine
vocabulary.example: Could you look in on him while we're away?

vocabulary.vi: hộp khóa (đựng chìa khóa, mở bằng mã số)
vocabulary.definition: a small locked box, opened with a code, that holds a key
vocabulary.example: The key is in a lockbox by the back door.

vocabulary.definition: held by a strap or rope attached to the dog's collar
vocabulary.example: Please keep him on the leash near the creek.

vocabulary.vi: huề nhau, không ai nợ ai
vocabulary.definition: used to say that nobody owes the other person anything any more
vocabulary.example: Bring me back some smoked salmon and we're even.

vocabulary.definition: a person who helps you out of a difficult situation
vocabulary.example: Thanks so much, you're a lifesaver.

vocabulary.definition: to become familiar with someone or something
vocabulary.example: Bring him over so he can get used to us.
